eoe.text: Sami is determined to find their cat Mirri after she weftwalks away and vanishes, and the search takes them and Tannuk to Sigma's Reach, a brightly lit colony that scans show to be hot and entirely lifeless.
Among hundreds of empty slipsuits and bodies baked into the clay, Sami falls into the quality assurance cyst after a stone moves in the pool, and wakes aboard the Seriema with fuzzy memory.
Sami later concludes that the stone is making them lucky enough to avoid detection and may have rewritten the past to empty Sigma's Reach, and they tell Tezzeret that the stone changes the past.
When Tezzeret threatens Haliya, Sami says they will detonate the ship if they have to, and at Infinite Guideline Sami tells Mantis the whole story of the artifact.
Finally, after Mantis sacrifices her mechan and hurls them to an old ship hulk, Sami opens a stasis cask and finds Mirri, who had weftwalked into it and been frozen in time.
